pr_title: Attempt to fix spectator list showing other users in multiplayer room even if they're not spectating better
pr_body:
Maybe closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/31972. Not sure. I have no reproduction scenario to work with, no solid understanding of how the issue can happen, and if this doesn't fix it, then I'm not even entirely sure how this can ever be fixed client-side.

The working theory is that not watching updates to the room provoked a situation wherein the room was temporarily not in a correct state when `WatchingUsers` changed, therefore the collection change callback failed to exclude other players in the room from display.

I'm only PRing this because of the `next-release` tag on the issue, and I'm not pursuing a server-side fix because of https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/31819#issuecomment-2642057859.
pr_comments: The changes here look sane enough. I don't see why we can't give this a try with some manual testing?

> I don't see why we can't give this a try with some manual testing?

I'm not sure what I should be doing here - I did test this manually on staging, and nothing was broken, but I couldn't reproduce the breakage at all to begin with, so that doesn't necessarily mean anything.

I more meant "can we mark this ready for review with the assumption that manual tests are enough and missing test coverage is not an issue"?

I'd like to get this in and see if users can still break things.
Not sure if undrafting bumps things into notifications so I'm just gonna comment instead

issue_context.title: Spectator list filled with room players in multiplayer
issue_context.body:
### Type

Game behaviour

### Bug description

I was playing in a multiplayer room (teams, freestyle fwiw). At a certain point during the map, the spectator list appeared even though it was empty, and later it became filled with the players in the room, even myself, but the number in parenthesis stayed at 1 or 2.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8077bafc-fa2a-4635-a0f0-d450981fa3e9)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b7837393-fcc5-4d45-9780-25af3d8375a9)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/86f7e9dd-ef97-4d99-b5e2-ddc4d924a703)

I have added the spectator list in the skin like this, only in this layer:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8fc364ac-1475-4d25-ab78-dcab46061bf2)

### Screenshots or videos

_No response_

### Version

2025.220.0

### Logs

[logs.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18889641/logs.zip)
comments: Was supposed to be fixed in https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/31844, but I guess it wasn't enough.

~~This happens when there's a break during a multiplayer map from my experience.~~

edit: nvm it just so happened to line up with breaks when it happened

@Theighlin it's a bit difficult to tell which portions of the log are potentially significant. are you able to indicate which beatmap you were playing at the time or something? or narrow down at what time exactly this happened in some way? also were you having any connection drop-outs or similar problems?

It was the last beatmap of the session, around here i guess
`2025-02-20 15:28:47 [verbose]: Song select updating selection with beatmap: DECO*27 - Ghost Rule (Awaken) [CRN's Extra] 78d64c42-9fd8-4fc9-9c23-2cb4983b759b ruleset:osu`

No connection dropouts (never had connection issues on lazer, i couldn't check while playing, but it was probably fine)
If you're asking to narrow it down during the play the closest thing would be song progress...

to clarify: you're saying that the gameplay started with an empty spectator list, then spectators appeared, then disappeared again? are you 100% sure they weren't there from the very start, but e.g. not visible because you had HUD hidden or something?

because if that's not what's happening then i have like zero idea as to what is happening here. i can't reproduce this on staging, and no other scenarios make sense. i don't think this can be anything to do with reconnection at this point either.
No, HUD was always visible, the spectator list was not present at the start, then appeared empty, then filled with players and i think it disappeared towards the end.

Can't guarantee this, but this might only happen if the lobby size is large enough. I've been playing multis for a few days and only noticed it if lobby sizes are ~10+ (give or take). If you're doing manual testing, I would maybe recommend trying larger lobby sizes to see if that's a component to the issue.

I can confirm this happens in a specific scenario where a lobby is 10+ players and a player quits the current match or a player starts spectating mid-game (while someone else is already spectating in both scenarios), in very very rare cases it just happens on its own

review_comments: What happens if the multiplayer client updates first? Not sure entirely how possible this is down this path, but it's difficult to think about...

`removePlayersFromMultiplayerRoom()` runs both on changes to `watchingUsers` and on changes to the multiplayer room. So I'm not sure why ordering would change anything here, both possible orderings should be handled?

It may mean that a user may momentarily be added to `actualSpectators` only to then be removed immediately after, but I decided this was much easier to parse than attempting to inline the multiplayer checks into the `watchingUsers` collection change callback.
